title: Senior Service Logistics Analyst
description:
JOB TITLE: Senior Service Logistics Analyst
LOCATION: Euless, TX
DURATION: 12 months
RATE RANGE: $35-$45/hr

COMPANY:
Our client is a global leader in AI and high-performance computing, powering innovations in gaming, robotics, and data science.


Job Description:
We are seeking a Senior Service Logistics Analyst to join our Service Fulfillment team and work directly with our North America Warehousing and Distribution 3PL. This 3PL manages product returns along with material storage and outbound shipments to customers.

As part of our growing U.S. supply chain operations, you’ll have the opportunity to drive immediate impact by improving processes, enhancing partner performance, and ensuring on-time delivery for customers across North America and globally.

What You’ll Be Doing
  • Provide on-site daily support at the 3PL warehouse in Euless, TX, plus remote support for other 3PL and DC service providers in North America.

  • Collaborate with Planning, Logistics, Engineering, Repair Operations, and Sales to streamline returns and fulfill orders efficiently.

  • Investigate service misses, issue corrective actions, and drive root cause resolution for SLA gaps.
  • Ensure customer RMA returns are routed and processed accurately.
  • Partner with warehouse teams to implement continuous process improvements.
  • Manage the shipment backlog/issue log in collaboration with Sales, Account Management, CQE, and CPM teams; escalate as needed.
  • Prepare performance scorecards and metrics for quarterly business reviews (QBRs).
  • Lead and support projects that improve operational efficiency and customer experience.

What We’re Looking For
  • BS degree or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years’ experience in warehouse operations, distribution centers, or logistics.
  • Proactive, start-up mindset with flexibility to take on expanding responsibilities as the business grows.
  • Strong proficiency in MS Office (Word, PowerPoint) and advanced Excel skills.
  • Experience in sales order execution for high-value, high-tech, and high-mix products.
  • Hands-on experience with Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) and Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) tools such as SAP.

Ways to Stand Out
  • Background in service logistics or operations support within a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated partnership-building skills with suppliers and 3PL/4PL providers.
  • Knowledge of data analytics and/or warehouse automation systems.
  • Proven ability to adapt to changing priorities and schedules.
  • Strong integrity, initiative, and attention to detail, with a collaborative working style.

COMPANY:
Our client is a global e-commerce platform that connects buyers and sellers to exchange goods across various categories.

About the Team and the Role
Our team of UX researchers guide design partners and cross-functional teams to Client, interpret, and act upon insights and opportunities with a persistent focus on the best possible experience for the customer.

We contribute to all phases of product development, and influence product and business strategy while we're at it.

In this role, you'll be an integral part of the C2C Local & Global Expansion team, with a primary focus on three markets: AU, FR, and IT. You will help shape the future of customer experience for C2C sellers and buyers in those markets, working side-by-side with other cross-functional partners to improve and evolve the C2C buying and selling experience on marketplace.

You’ll engage deeply in market-specific research, developing rich expertise in market nuances and buyer and seller behaviors to ensure that our insights are tailored, actionable, and grounded in real customer needs.

You’ll work closely with cross-functional partners in Design, Product, Business, Engineering, and Product Marketing across these markets to create meaningful experiences that truly resonate with our customers.

What You Will Accomplish
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams as you define research questions, devise the methodological approach, and conduct timely, insightful research across the product lifecycle.
  • Own the full spectrum of user research, including planning, execution, synthesis, and dissemination of findings to inform product development.
  • Partner with Product and Design teams to translate research insights into actionable product improvements and ensure user needs are central to decision-making.
  • Identify and prioritize impactful research opportunities in collaboration with the Research Lead and stakeholders within the Fashion & Home Goods teams.
  • Lead and manage vendor/agency research projects, coordinating with external consultants as necessary to achieve project goals.
  • Employ storytelling and workshop facilitation to share research insights, fostering a culture of empathy and action-oriented decision-making within the team.

What You Will Bring
  • Experience: 10+ years in UX research in a corporate or consultancy setting working with Fortune 500 companies. Consulting experience is a plus.
  • Education: Master's or PhD in Anthropology, Sociology, Psychology, Human Factors, or related field.
  • Proven Impact on Product Strategy: Demonstrated success in influencing product strategy through actionable UX research insights.
  • Advanced Qualitative Expertise: Brings deep experience in qualitative research, with the ability to lead and execute studies across the product development lifecycle — from early discovery through to launch. Proficiency in quantitative methods or a mixed methods background is an advantage.
  • Critical Thinking: Highly adept at navigating complex issues within ambiguous environments, demonstrating the capacity to lead initiatives with minimal supervision.
  • AI-Enhanced Research Mindset: Comfortable leveraging AI-powered tools to increase research efficiency and scale, while maintaining rigorous standards of research integrity, methodological soundness, and insight quality and validity.
  • Design Thinking Acumen: Knowledgeable in design thinking practices and processes with experience in workshop facilitation.
  • Outstanding Communication: Strong communication skills with the ability to advocate for user research with executive leadership, as well as Product, Design, and Business partners.
  • Team Collaboration: Comfortable working in large, cross-functional teams dispersed across offices and regions.
  • Global Research & Ecommerce Experience: Prior experience in ecommerce or global research is beneficial. German, Italian or French language skills are a plus, but not a requirement.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • BS in Computer Science, OR equivalent game development/engine experience.

  • 4+ years development experience in Python, C#, or C++.
  • 3+ years of experience with Unreal (infrastructure/tools/plugins).
  • Knowledge in game development, tools, and pipelines including: working with 3D assets, scripting/tool development, shaders (GLSL/HSLG), VFX, post-processing, and/or procedural effects and animations.

POSITION SUMMARY:

We are seeking a highly motivated Integration Engineer to join our Factory Software Team. In this role, you will be responsible for integrating new manufacturing lines with our homegrown Factory, Warehouse, and ERP systems and providing ongoing support to ensure their smooth daily operation. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to drive system integration projects and troubleshoot production issues to maintain the operational health of our systems.   • +1 year of experience with Python, Go, or other software development languages for automating tasks and integrating systems
  • Solid understanding of integrated systems and their dependencies, particularly within manufacturing and enterprise environments
  • Experience with system integration and working in environments that use MES, WMS, and ERP systems is a strong plus
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a constantly changing environment

JOB DESCRIPTION
Summary
As a Manufacturing Diagnostics Engineer, you will be a part of the team that executes processes to bring up, validate, test, and troubleshoot the vehicle as well as implements diagnostic systems / infrastructure. You will develop and improve our processes for testing the electrical and firmware systems of a vehicle to perform the End-of-Line diagnostics in the manufacturing process.

Responsibilities
  • Serve as the first line of defense for all electrical and functional issues on the manufacturing line including but not limited to software / firmware, harness, networking (CAN, LIN, Automotive and Standard Ethernet, GMSL, etc.), hardware, and infrastructure issues.
  • Validate vehicle behavior, triage issues, identify root causes, and lead resolutions (pertaining to software, tooling, deploy, harness, hardware, etc.) during vehicle manufacturing testing, bring-up, firmware updates, and calibration.
  • Work closely with multidisciplinary engineers to collect and interpret the component and vehicle level requirements and translate them into scalable system-level validation test scripts and test cases
  • Develop the system for automatic troubleshooting and workaround guidance for operators on the Manufacturing line
  • Build test plans and test coverage for vehicle production, incorporating vehicle behaviors, functionalities, and manufacturing cycle times
  • Design and implement future manufacturing lines involving the next generation diagnostic architecture to support higher volume production
Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant area such as Electrical Engineering or Computer Science.
  • Very strong troubleshooting and debugging skills and experience, including reading, troubleshooting, and injecting packets over various network protocols such as CAN, LIN, and Ethernet
  • 2-4 years of experience with automotive controller integration testing or test script development / programming in high-level languages such as Python
  • Experience with Github or similar tools for software management
  • Strong background in Linux and shell / bash / terminal scripting
Bonus Qualifications
  • Master’s degree in a relevant area such as Computer Science or Engineering
  • Experience with integration and automation of manufacturing and test equipment
  • Background in creating, reading, and writing to tables in SQL database
  • Experience with computer network engineering, TCP / IP protocols, communication over API
